page.overview:
Who is List of JoJo Musicians?

SOUL'd OUT was a Japanese hip-hop band who were active from 1999 to 2014. They performed "VOODOO KINGDOM", the theme song to the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Phantom Blood animated movie.

The group's members were Main MC Diggy-MO, Human Beatbox and MC Bro.Hi, and Trackmaster Shinnosuke. The band parted ways in 2014, with Shinnosuke's desire to leave the group for personal reasons as one of the main reasons behind their breakup.

TOMMY is a Japanese singer and the vocalist of a Japanese rock band BLUFF. He made his solo debut performing "JoJo ~Sono Chi no Sadame~", the 1st opening for JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Animation.

Coda is a Japanese singer-songwriter, composer and sound producer. Born and raised in , Japan, Coda was originally the vocalist of a Japanese rock band before going under a pseudonym to perform "BLOODY STREAM", the 2nd opening for JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Animation. He has also performed the 1st opening for JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Golden Wind, "Fighting Gold", as well as the ending theme of the Kishibe Rohan wa Ugokanai OVA, "FINDING THE TRUTH".
